# overlay regulation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayRegulation`](gmeow-overlayRegulation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayRegulation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The machine-readable rights statement (permissions, prohibitions, duties) that governs activity within this overlay. Links to the rights facility by reference. Non-functional: multiple legal instruments may apply to the same overlay (e.g. national law + international treaty + local ordinance).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RegulatoryOverlay`](../classes/gmeow-RegulatoryOverlay.md) -> [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md)
